name: Flutterpage
bio: Archetype: Extra Action, AFK AoE DPT, +AP. ⌽ Gains [Gust] after any action is taken and deploys a forcefield at turn start based on [Gust] count. ⌽ Tier 1: Allies' attacks deal additional Reality damage, more so if the attack consumed Eureka. ⌽ Tier 2: Additionally, extra actions deal increased damage and Genesis damage based on [Gust] count. ⌽ Tier 3: Additionally, extra actions guarantee crits and deal increased damage and Genesis damage based on ally Crit stats. ⌽ S2 gives +1 AP next turn. ⌽ Ultimate converts all skills in-hand to AoE incantations and cast them automatically as Extra Actions.
